skills.name: Temporal Deceit
skills.description: The enemy hero directly opposite the holder will join the battle 1.25 seconds late.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: The first time the holder receives fatal damage, they are immune to the damage and revert to their position and status 5 seconds ago.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: When reverting, their health and energy return to their optimal state from within the last 5 seconds.

skills.name: Clashing Waves
skills.description: When the holder uses their Ultimate skill, they enter the Phased status for 6 seconds, during which they receive 20 points of Attack Speed and 20 points of Crit Rating.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: While in the Phased status, when the holder deals critical strike damage, the phase inflicts additional damage equal to 30% of the damage value.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: The holder recovers health equal to 60% of the additional damage dealt.

skills.name: Time Control
skills.description: After entering the battlefield, the holder stops time for 3 seconds the first time they receive damage. During this time, only the holder can move. Each time this effect is triggered, the duration of the same effect subsequently triggered by an allied hero is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: Every 0.5 seconds the time is stopped, Inertia inflicts damage equal to 15% of the holder's max health on an enemy hero.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: Inertia reduces the energy of the damaged enemy hero by 70 points.

skills.name: Soul Suction
skills.description: Every 8 seconds, the enemy hero with the highest health is prioritized as the target, where 10% of their max health is stolen and converted into the holder's shield for 5 seconds. When the shield ends, the remaining shield value is converted back into health of equal value to be returned to the target.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: While the shield is active, the target's Attack Rating and Defense Rating are reduced by 20% and 20% respectively.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: While the shield is active, the holder receives Attack Rating and Defense Rating lost by the target.

skills.name: Divine Sanction
skills.description: Every 4 times the holder inflicts normal attack damage on a single enemy hero, the target suffers additional damage equal to 200% of the holder's Attack Rating.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: The enemy receiving additional damage is stunned for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: Each time additional damage is triggered, the holder's normal attack damage is increased by 8%, up to 5 stacks.

skills.name: Boiling Berserker
skills.description: When inflicting control effects, the holder slices the target for 4 seconds. The sliced target suffers health loss equal to 80% of the holder's Attack Rating every 1 second. If the target's position changes within 1 second, their health loss is increased to 120% of the holder's Attack Rating.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: When an enemy's health loss from being sliced exceeds 12% of their max health, they become terrified for 3 seconds. This effect can only be triggered on a target once every 8 seconds.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: When the slice effect attempts to terrify an enemy target, the Twisted Fate is triggered and deals damage equaling 250% of the holder's Attack Rating to enemies near the target.

skills.name: Beguiling Whispers
skills.description: When the holder's Ultimate skill ends, they charm the nearest enemy hero for 2 seconds. The charmed enemy can only use their normal attack.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: Meanwhile, the holder summons a minion that continuously attacks the nearest enemy hero, dealing damage equaling 200% of the holder's Attack Rating, while restoring the holder's health for 100% of their damage value. The holder can possess up to 1 minion.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: When the holder takes a single instance of damage that exceeds 15% of their max health, they sacrifice 1 minion to mitigate the damage.

skills.name: Dark Portal
skills.description: When the holder's Ultimate skill ends, they summon an alternate time-space above the enemy hero with the highest energy, dealing AoE damage equal to 120% of the holder's Attack Rating and erasing 50 energy points of the damaged enemy hero.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: The enemy hero suffering damage from the alternate time-space will be marked with Eye of Evil. When they have been marked 3 times, Cuffs of Destruction are generated to erase 300 energy points of the target.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: When the target's energy is erased, their energy shortfall is converted into the holder's energy recovery, for at least 30 points.

skills.name: Strategic Supplies
skills.description: When the battle has progressed for 6 seconds, the holder sets up a Supplies Stall at its formation location, with 2 bottles of Health potion and 1 bottle of Energy potion, which can restore the health of a surrounding allied hero for 200% of the holder's Attack Rating as well as 200 energy points respectively.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: Each type of potion is replenished 8 seconds after it is finished, and can be replenished up to 2 times per battle.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: An extra mysterious potion is added to the stall, for use by the allied hero who has dealt the highest cumulative damage, to increase 30% of their Attack Rating for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Dream Hopper
skills.description: The first time the holder receives fatal damage, they are immune to the damage, recover 30% of their max health and flashes for 2 seconds. While flashing, the holder cannot be targeted.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: When the flashing ends, the enemy hero closest to the holder falls into a dream, and wakes up after 4 seconds or suffering cumulative damage equal to 40% of their max health.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: Every 10 seconds, the enemy hero closest to the holder falls into a dream.

skills.name: Surging Infusion
skills.description: When the holder finishes casting their Ultimate, they are infused with a massive dose of chemicals for 6 seconds, during which they recover a total amount of health equal to 300% of Attack Rating, gain 12 points of Haste, plus 15% Attack Rating. This effect is removed if the holder suffers a healing prevention effect.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: The holder causes a noxious explosion every 8 seconds, dealing damage equal to 160% of Attack Rating to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: The attribute-boosting effects of the chemicals can be stacked up to 2 times.

skills.name: Battlecry Resounds
skills.description: After the holder enters battle, all allied heroes gain a shield that offsets damage up to 12% of the holder's max health. The shield lasts for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: After battle begins, the holder will use Battlecry Resounds an extra time every 15 seconds, for up to 3 times.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: The holder commands the battlefield, granting all nearby allied heroes 15 points of Damage Resist and 20 points of Tenacity. This effect does not stack.

skills.name: Blade Waltz
skills.description: For every 6 critical strikes the holder lands, a blade slash is triggered, dealing an extra 3 strikes of damage equal to 120% of Attack Rating. Up to 3 blade slashes can be triggered every 5 seconds, and blade slashes themselves will not re-trigger this effect when they land a critical strike.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: The holder's damage is increased by 30% if they have not received damage for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: When the holder lands a critical strike, their Attack Rating is increased by 4% for 8 seconds, for up to 6 stacks.

skills.name: Stormy Retribution
skills.description: When the holder deals damage to an enemy, they become Electrified, reducing their Damage Resist by 15 points for 4 seconds. This effect cannot be stacked. For every 3 strikes of damage the holder deals to an Electrified enemy, a lightning bolt will be triggered, dealing AoE damage equal to 250% of the holder's Attack Rating. Can be triggered up to 1 time every 6 seconds.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: For every 1 Electrified enemy present on the battlefield, the holder's damage dealt increases by 7%, for up to a maximum boost of 21%.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: When the holder attacks an Electrified enemy that is suffering from a control effect, Attack Power is further increased by 60% of initial Attack Rating.

skills.name: Burning Target
skills.description: After the holder enters the battlefield, places a Bounty on the nearest enemy hero for 15 seconds, causing them to take 10% more damage, for up to a maximum increase of 40%.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: When an allied hero deals damage to a Bountied enemy, they gain 20 points of Crit Rating and 15 points of Crit Damage Amplification, and they also receive healing equal to 120% of the holder's Attack Rating. Healing can be triggered up to 1 time every 3 seconds.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: The damage taken by Bountied enemies is increased to 20%.

skills.name: Terror Chain
skills.description: After entering battle, if there are no enemy units within range, the holder launches a talon hook that pulls the enemy unit with the smallest angle relative to the holder in front of itself and stuns them for 4s. Enemies hit by the talon hook have their Defense Rating reduced by 30% for 7s.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: Every 2 times the holder uses their Ultimate, all enemies are terrified for 2s.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: The holder inflicts 120% more damage and health loss to enemy units that have less than 30% health and are within normal attack range. If the holder kills an enemy hero, they can launch the talon hook again.

skills.name: Thorny Mark
skills.description: Every 25s while the holder survives, inflicts Thorny Mark for 8s on the enemy unit with the highest current Attack Rating. Enemy units with Thorny Mark suffer health loss equal to 200% of the holder's Attack Rating for every 6 strikes of damage they take.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: When enemy units with Thorny Mark lose health, the Collection holder gains health equal to 10% of the health lost by the affected unit (capped at 100% of the holder's Attack Rating).

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: Enemy units with Thorny Mark suffer 30% more damage and health loss (capped at an increase of 50%).

skills.name: Banishing Zone
skills.description: Upon entering the battlefield, the holder summons a Banishing Zone beneath themselves for 8s. During this time, the damage and health loss suffered by the holder are both reduced by 25%, while damage and health loss taken by enemies within the zone are both increased by 25%.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: Each time a summoned unit dies in battle, the holder's Attack Rating increases by 4% for 10s (capped at 12 stacks). After 3 summoned units have died, the Banishing Zone is reactivated for 8s or its current duration is increased by 8s.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: While the Banishing Zone is active, the first time the holder takes fatal damage, they become immune to that damage and become invincible for a certain duration. The current zone is removed and cannot be summoned again. For the next 6s, the holder takes 30% less damage and health loss.

skills.name: Lunar Guardian
skills.description:
When the holder joins battle, they gain Selene's Lunar Guardian. Every 3 times the holder uses an active skill, the guardian switches between New Moon and Full Moon. Starts with the New Moon.
Each time the holder gains the Lunar Guardian in New Moon form, they resist the next 2 strikes of damage. Each time the guardian is in Full Moon form, they deal 15% more damage (capped at a max increase of 30%).

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: While New Moon is active, the holder recovers health equal to 30% of the damage they deal. While Full Moon is active, the holder deals increased damage (capped at a max increase of 60%).

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: While Full Moon is active, each of the holder's strikes of damage deals extra normal attack damage equal to 50% of their Attack Rating. Can be triggered up to 1 times every 1s.

skills.name: Forsworn Tide
skills.description: The holder blows the Bone Conch every 8s, recovering 40% of their max health, recording their health value after healing, and gaining Bone Conch Echo for 4s. When Bone Conch Echo ends, if the holder's health is below the recorded value, it will be restored back to that value. The restored value cannot exceed 60% of the holder's max health.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: While Bone Conch Echo is active, the holder is surrounded by smoke, increasing their Dodge by 80 points and granting immunity to knockback effects.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: The first time the holder takes fatal damage, they become immune to that damage, their health is restored to the value recorded when the Bone Conch was last blown, and they become immune to damage for 2s.

skills.name: Scorched Ward
skills.description: When the holder joins battle, the 2 allied heroes with the highest initial Attack Rating will gain Scorched Ward (prioritizing heroes that do not currently have Scorched Ward), which reduces the damage and health loss the hero takes by 40%. This effect is reduced by 1% every 1s until it reaches 25%. Each hero can only have 1 Scorched Ward.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: Whenever the damage reduction effect of Scorched Ward on an allied hero is reduced 1 time, that hero recovers 40 Energy, and their Energy Recovery Rate is permanently increased by 1 point.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: When the holder joins battle, an extra 1 allied hero will gain Scorched Ward. Whenever the damage reduction effect of Scorched Ward on an allied hero is reduced 1 time, that hero's Attack Rating is permanently increased by 3%.

skills.name: Bestial Ward
skills.description:
When the holder joins battle, they gain Bestial Ward for 6s. While the effect is active, it blocks 5 Heavy Blows for the holder. Each Heavy Blow can only cause the holder to lose up to 15% health. (Heavy Blow: a single strike of damage that exceeds 15% of the holder's max health.)
When the holder damages an enemy unit, a Wolf Spirit appears and bites them, dealing damage equal to 5% of the enemy unit's current health (damage capped at 500% of the holder's Attack Rating). Can trigger 3 times per second.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description: Whenever the holder's health drops below 50%, their Bestial Ward is refreshed, they recover 5 blocks, and they gain a shield worth 100% of their max health. Can trigger once every 5s.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description: Each time a Wolf Spirit bites an enemy unit to deal damage, 50% of the damage is converted into healing for the holder, while the enemy unit takes 12% more damage for 3s (max 5 stacks).

skills.name: Maritime Rating
skills.description:
The holder gains a Maritime Rating, starting with a rating of B. This rating increases each time the holder damages enemy units 5 times. The rating increases further when the holder uses their Ultimate.
B: Increases Defense by 40%. A: Increases Attack Rating by 25%. S: Increases Physical Pierce by 30 points. SS: Increases Crit Rating and Crit Damage Amplification by 45 points.

skills.name: Skill Level +1
skills.description:
At the start of battle, the holder summons the Ape Admiral, which follows the enemy hero with the lowest health, increasing the damage and health loss that hero takes by 20%.
When the enemy hero the Ape Admiral is following uses their Ultimate, the Ape Admiral leaps and howls, reducing that hero's Attack Rating by 30% for 5s.

skills.name: Skill Level +2
skills.description:
When the holder takes fatal damage, he becomes immune to that damage and gains brief invincibility, while also recovering health and Energy based on his rating. Can trigger 1 time per battle.
Each time the holder's rating increases, they recover 50% of their max health and 200 Energy.
